        return

        while i <= p - 1:

            i += 1
        j = (p - 1) // i
        ans = 1

            ans = (ans * p) % A
        ans %= A
        print(ans)
    elif k == 1:
        ans = 1
        for _ in range(p):
            ans = (ans * p) % A
        print(ans)
    elif k == 0:
        ans = 1
        for _ in range(p - 1):
            ans = (ans * p) % A
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
